clean_tooling_verify.subsequent_edits: Documentation wording only in production; one test method renamed and all eight controller tests rerun. No later production behavior change.

accepted_request_behaviors: Fresh owned-tree readings replace stale caller-provided residency before admission; earliest submission selected.
Missing live-tree readings issue no START or RESUME; fresh successful readings reconsider the original queue order.
Host read failures and invalid negative residency propagate without control requests.
Incomplete measurements do not advance swap history; later complete readings compare with the last complete cycle.
Invalid snapshots are rejected before either measurement or control boundary.
WAIT issues no control; an applying failure is propagated without a retry within that cycle.
upstream_comparison: No upstream counterpart: this controller and its tests are downstream build tooling; upstream source/tests remain unchanged.
